name: Bisacodyl
executiveSummary: Contact stimulant laxative. Adult: **5–10 mg PO at night** or **10 mg rectal**. Pediatrics ≥4 y: **5 mg PO** or **5 mg** suppository (ages per label). PO onset ~6–12 h; rectal ~15–60 min.
indications:
## Indications

- Occasional constipation; bowel prep (with other agents).

## Precautions

- Avoid chronic daily use without evaluation (dependence, electrolyte imbalance).
- Avoid in obstruction, acute abdomen, severe dehydration, appendicitis.
- Do not crush/chew enteric tablets; do not take with milk/antacids at the same time.

> Prefer diet measures and osmotics (PEG) in chronic functional constipation.

adulto.dose: **5–10 mg PO at bedtime**. Rectal: **10 mg** when rapid evacuation needed.
adulto.administration: PO whole with water; rectal per technique.
adulto.notes: Colon prep: higher doses in protocols — do not self-medicate.

pediatrico.dose: ≥10 y: as adult. 4–10 y: **5 mg PO night** or **5 mg** rectal. <4 y: only if label/pediatrician (often rectal **5 mg** only).
pediatrico.notes: In children prefer osmotics and habits.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Cramps, diarrhea, nausea; prolonged use: hypokalemia; rectal: local irritation.
